newsitem.title: USA: Jean Philippe relinquishes Cutex license.
newsitem.headline: Jean Philippe relinquishes Cutex license.

text.p: Jean Philippe Fragrances Inc said Friday it completed a transaction in which it relinquished its Cutex nail and lip products license to Carson Products Co, a unit of Carson Inc.
In a statement, Jean Philippe said that at the closing, all current Cutex inventory was purchased and certain liabilities assummed by Carson Products. The amount of the deal was not disclosed.

It said it gave up the license as part of a previously announced restructuring of its domestic operations that aims to focus its resources on what it said was its profitable core business: alternative designer fragrances.

It said that, as part of the restructuring, it reduced its workforce and expects to incur a pre-tax charge against earnings of approximately $1.3 million for the first quarter of 1997 to write off intangible assets and other expenses relating to relinquishing the Cutex license.
It said it expects to report earnings for first quarter of fiscal 1997 by May 9.
A Jean Phillippe spokesman was unavailable to provide details on the workforce reduction.
